He seems as if he's forgotten how to smile. However, he learns what it means to be happy through Jay, and Jay cherishes him as her own precious Hunny bunny.

193008.description:
Today, I was dumped by Kim Yeo-Hee again. Countless confessions, countless rejections. This is love, it was too horrible.

“You’ve become a fool while Je-Gyeom wasn’t looking?”
“…That’s okay. Just go home and adjust to the time difference.”

I was already miserable, but Baek Hyun-Oh, who had suddenly returned from the US, started to tease me with ridiculous words.

“Hey, what would you do if I seduced her?”
“I couldn’t do it, so how could you?”
“I’ll do it. I’m not a fool like some people.”

It was a crappy bet. But why? It was funny, but my heart wavered dangerously at Baek Hyun-Oh’s teasing. I shouldn’t have done this, but I wanted to know Kim Yeo-Hee’s true feelings.

“Just give me three months. I’ll get Kim Yeo-Hee’s button.”

It was the beginning of a dangerous bet.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193009.description:
Kazuki, who works as a system engineer, reunites with his childhood friend Mayu, whom he has had a crush on for many years. Mayu has returned to her hometown and is helping out at her family's public bathhouse, Yomogi-yu, while also working as an illustrator. She apparently broke up with her boyfriend a year ago. Kazuki thinks this is his chance to tell her how he feels, but Mayu responds that she wants to have sex before deciding whether to date him. Since then, Kazuki has been hearing Mayu's sex stories at the bathhouse...

Kazuma and Yuuya are stepbrothers who are actually lovers and live under one roof (in their parents' house), secretly doing the things lovers do under their parents' radar. A particular close call is intercepted by Kazuma's quick-thinking. While Yuuya is determined to keep their relationship under wraps, he also begins to feel anxious and conflicted for how long they can keep it a secret.

On the other hand, Kazuma meets Yuuya's student, Matsubara, from his part-time as a cram school tutor by chance when they're out shopping. Seeing their closeness, Kazuma's instincts tells him that he should keep an eye out for him. He is also curious how Yuuya is doing at the cram school, with Yuuya having a charm that attracts those younger than him...

193019.description:
Asuka Sumi, who works from home, bumps into his next-door neighbor, college student Rentaro Taniguchi, outside their apartment building one day. Asuka has a bit of a sweet tooth, and, wouldn't you know it, Rentaro works part-time at a cake shop. As Rentaro starts bringing Asuka cakes from work every day despite his glaring lack of exercise, he proposes a rather... unorthodox way for Asuka to get some exercise and satisfy his desire for cake at the same time.

Laughs galore in this romantic comedy BL between a promiscuous younger stud with an especially rigorous exercise routine and his cake-loving slob of a neighbor.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

193020.description:
An omegaverse romance between a playboy alpha and a virgin omega!

Kazuki is the second son of the Sasakura family, a famous family of alphas. He's enjoyed a free life full of sex without ever looking for a mate, but suddenly, he's forced into an arranged engagement! And his partner is none other than Kaoru Kunioka, a quiet hottie from his university who's the heir to another alpha family! People say that Kaoru is the perfect alpha, but he's actually an omega who's just never had a heat induced before. There's no way Kazuki's attracted to Kaoru's rugged, manly body, but it seems that Kaoru is “flawed" and he wants Kazuki to use his alpha pheromones to see if there's something wrong with him. Kazuki promises to help him if Kaoru will call off the engagement once they're done, but will he be able to make Kaoru into a naughty omega?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

An omegaverse romance between a hot, obsessed alpha and an omega with a frightening face!

Ao is a poor omega who works part-time jobs to get by. One day, he finds a job as a test subject for heat suppressants! But when he shows up at the company, he suddenly gets his virginity stolen by a beautiful man! That man had instantly realized that Ao was an omega even though his stern face led others to think he was a beta. He even became Ao's stalker, but he was actually Sakuya Nishina, the pharmaceutical company's representative! Ao obtains suppressants under the condition that he allows Sakuya to try and seduce him. Will Ao be swept away by the intense love attack of the top alpha elite Sakuya?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

Turns out, he spent the night with honor student and "fairy prince" Sho Shioya, naked in his bed! Just one look at the sleeping prince and his pretty posterior tells Kuniaki he must have taken advantage of the boy. But it starts to dawn on Kuniaki that it was actually the other way around!

A riotous romantic comedy about a party boy who discovers a whole new world of sensation!

(Source: MANGA.CLUB)

title.english: The Doggy And The Fairy Prince

193024.description:
Obnoxious drunk and self-proclaimed life of the party Kuniaki Sako is a typical college student with more free time and energy than he knows what to do with. That is, until he gets picked up by the angelic Sho Shioya, who teaches him a whole new world of sensation. After a bunch of twists and turns, the pair become a happy couple. When Kuniaki tells his best friend, Nan, the news, she tells him that if he's going to date Sho, he needs to learn to act like a human... And, that means learning self-awareness and responsibility. Can Kuniaki, the infamously "cute drunk" (according to Sho), really manage to do that...!?

Follow the antics of boyfriends Sho and Kuniaki, and their happy-go-lucky college friends, in this new nonstop action-packed romantic comedy series!!

(Source: Renta!)

Mashimo, a former police officer, now works as a handyman, taking on odd jobs that often involve dealing with “demi-humans”—people with animal-like traits. One day, on his way back from a job in a city where demi-humans live, he reunites with Crow, a snake demi-human who once helped him in the past. Mashimo finds Crow crouched down, looking weak and exhausted, and tries to take care of him. However, as a snake demi-human, Crow has a certain instinct: when his body grows cold, he must warm it through sexual contact…?! Pinned beneath Crow, the two end up spending the night together. Mashimo assumes it will be a one-time thing—but it seems Crow has taken quite a liking to him…?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Parents drowning in debt. A controlling boyfriend who is emotionally abusive. University student Mina is in despair over her life, where she is constantly exploited financially and sexually.

When she puts on the lipstick and sucks out men's semen, they become exhausted and Mina feels a surge of strength. It's a lipstick that gives her the powers of a succubus...! Yeon, a lowly water serpent kept alive by the Azure Dragon’s divine power, finds herself carrying his child after a drunken night he cannot remember. Terrified that his pureblood ideals would mean certain death for her and her child, she hides the truth—until his suspicions begin to grow.

Nanami has just been proposed to by Tsuchiya, her boss, boyfriend and live-in partner. However, feeling that her relationship with him is at an impasse, Nanami runs away without being able to come up with an answer and is temporarily staying at her childhood friend Hiro's house. Hiro always gives Nanami warm love, even though she feels suffocated... This is a healing cohabitation story between two wounded people.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

193049.description:
Qiao Senna, a straight-A student who hates makeup, accidentally finds out that Ho Er, a handsome boy in her school, is the popular (female) beauty influencer Hera. She doesn't wanna get involved and decides to ignore that matter, but Ho Er doesn't wanna let her go and even asks her to take his job. Will Qiao Senna accept this request and starts to be a beauty blogger?

(Source: Webnovel)

193050.description:
When her father decided to move their family to a rural area, Miki Hayakawa and her younger brother went along with his plan. They didn't know that when they got to their new home, their father would tell them, "I'm going to declare independence from Japan and make this home a kingdom of our own."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

193051.description:
Kaylen came across a major setback in her life and headed back to the countryside to run away from all of this, one day she rescued a fox when she wandered around in the forest after she got drunk. But she didin't know that she will meet this "fox" again soon!

Kaylen's works were taken away by the powerful men, so she tried to take her revenge through her new novel. Just when her revenge was blocked, she met her strongest alliance, a little dumb and beautiful man with a strong and a smuggling body! Wait, why does he look so familiar?

The "Secret Exchange App" allows you to find out a secret about anyone, by entering a secret about someone else.

Buto, a student at Teito University, found out the truth behind a case of sexual assault on campus, and she felt compelled to anonymously report it through the app. However, in exchange, she is told a secret that she wished she didn't know. This is a suspense story that depicts the sordid ways that people become manipulated by social network apps.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

193053.description:
The hero Li Changan was sent back to the ancient world by a magical yellow book. Every time he killed a demon, he gained a magical power. When he killed hundreds of demons and drew his sword to look around, he found that all this was just a small wave before the rolling tide.

A world where everyone has their own clichés. Baek Seo-Na’s wild school life where she wants to be successful in life and avoid boring clichés.

193056.description:
The silence is over. Now his fight begins!

One day, Ji-Jun, a transfer student who never speaks, overpowers the bullies in his class with overwhelming skill. Because of this fight, Ji-Jun becomes the center of attention of the bullies inside and outside the school. And another silent female student begins to watch Ji-Jun.

(Source: Naver, translated)

193060.description:
Indifferent student Takatsugi-kun is living an uneventful life, until he meets Niina, a girl who's utterly obsessed with baseball. Though she seems to have nothing but baseball on her mind, Takatsugi finds himself drawn to her. Their relationship progresses smoothly...or does it? An unconventional triple-threat romantic comedy begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

193061.description:
Princess Soria has been cursed to live in her dilapidated kingdom as a chicken for the last century. Her curse can only be broken through true love with her Prince Charming. Unfortunately, the only fitting candidate for her comes in the form of Emperor Lenok, who doesn’t know a thing about romance! He also needs her help to save his empire from a long-term drought, a problem that can only be solved by breaking her curse and restoring her kingdom. But how is a poultry princess supposed to fall for such an unattractive ruler?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Mayumi Makimura is the confident, bright young daughter of a famous professor working on an experimental submarine, the plans for which are being hunted by the female terrorist, Phantom Mouse.

However, upon being hit by a meteor, Mayumi is given a form with otherworldly abilities. And in this form, she takes the name 'Super Rose'...

193063.description:
Sorang's one wish is to abandon the sluggish life of a half-human, half-goblin and become the perfect Korean goblin. However, when she crosses paths with a special human named Sujo in her shop, Sorang Studio, a budding romance forms. Will their different goals cause friction, or will they grow together?

(Source: Manta)

Yeon-Hwa dreams of mingling with a snake every night. She started having that dream on the day she saved a snake that was about to die. Jae-Yoon, his current boss and once his quiet admirer, steps in and offers to cover the debt for him. A single misunderstanding twists their intentions, pulling the two men into a complicated and unexpected new phase of their relationship.

(Source: Lezhin US)

193265.description:
"I'm curious about men, and since you're the only man in this house, I should at least see yours!"

Yeon-Seul became a widow after her husband died violently before they could even have their first night together. Yeon-Seul's curiosity about men only grows as she lives alone as a quiet, little housewife. Meanwhile, the good-looking and handsome servant Dol-Soe keeps lingering around her...

Now that her mother-in-law is away! Yeon-Seul can't hold back her curiosity and decides to drag Dol-Soe along.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: Dolswe, Let Me See It Just Once

title.native: スライムは最強たる可能性を秘めている～２回目の人生、ちゃんとスライムと向き合います～@COMIC
title.romaji: Slime wa Saikyou Taru Kanousei wo Himete Iru: Nikaime no Jinsei, Chanto Slime to Mukiaimasu @COMIC

193267.description:
“Thank goodness, I’m the first one to spend the night with you.”

Hye-Yoon, who became the eldest daughter of a prestigious family, was only a pretense of being a wife to her sick husband. However, due to her deceased husband’s will, all the circumstances surrounding her suddenly change. She must marry one of his half-brothers. However, instead of rejecting the will, the three brothers all step forward to take her as their wife, and she, who has no choice but to choose one of them, faces a new problem.

“According to tradition, a wife must spend one night with each of her brothers. After that, she can marry the one she wants from among them.”

What choice will she make?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

193269.description:
Kyung-Jin, who returned to his hometown with his wife after his father's death, finds out that he has incurred a huge debt due to his guarantee. The pastor kindly helps him in both material and spiritual ways, but he is somewhat uneasy...

What is the true nature of the ominous feeling that gradually surrounds Kyung-Jin?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

193270.description:
“While being manipulated by Yang Sa-Ae, I belong completely to Yang Sa-Ae.”

Yang Sa-ae was a former gladiator slave, as opposed to Ra Yu-Rak, who was a noble aristocrat and a general of her country. Yu-Rak was reduced to a slave after losing in war and was offered as a gift to Sa-Ae. Sa-Ae sexually tortured him without any feelings. The arrogant Yu-Rak eventually accepts the pain as pleasure and surrenders. While denying his surrender, he realizes his feelings for Sa-Ae. Yu-Rak becomes more and more desperate, clinging and obsessed, and yearning for love.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: All About Dominative and Exclusive Destruction

193271.description:
"Huh? Me? The vampire queen?"

In a world where vampires and humans coexist, an ordinary human named Han Ye-Seul ends up applying to Baekse High School, a school for only vampires, by a ridiculous mistake. In order not to be found out that she is human, she dyes her hair and wears contact lenses, but was it too much? Everyone sees her as a legendary pure-blooded vampire and reveres her as a queen!

Since it has come to this, I will play the role of the perfect vampire queen until I transfer in a year! Although she resolves this, her human nature is lost when Chan-Gyeol finds out about her in the bathroom. As she gets entangled with Chan-Gyeol, she continues to get involved in strange things.

Will Han Ye-Seul be able to safely complete her year at this vampire school teeming with vampires and transfer?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

193272.description:
The moment Arcelia woke up and found herself in a fantasy novel, she knew she was in trouble. Owning the power of a truth seeker didn't make life easier for her, either. Forced to pay the debts of a person she trusted, she strikes a deal with Duke Kasius Arren Ambrose, the most powerful person in the empire. Only Arcelia can help him return to his dragon form by helping him find the "Piece of God", and he is the only one who can save her from the loan sharks. Arcelia knows she shouldn't mix business and pleasure, but how can she resist when the Duke is the cutest man she's ever met?!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: 最强大公还能这么可爱呀？
เมื่อฉันพบว่าผู้ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดในโลกน่ารักเกินไป
Le secret de mon adorable Grand-Duc

title.english: Who Knew Dragons Could Be This Cute?
title.native: 孤高の公爵様が私にだけ可愛すぎます！
title.romaji: Kokou no Koushaku-sama ga Watashi ni dake Kawai Sugimasu!

193273.description:
Can their love stand the test of time travel?

Bung-Do Kim, a scholar from the Joseon Dynasty, is sent to the 21st century by a magic talisman, where he falls in love with Hee-Jin Choi, an actress. But after a terrible accident, Hee-Jin and Bung-do find themselves thrown back in time. Will they be able to find their way back to each other?

(Source: Manta)

193274.description:
"Rumor has it that you fucked Haruki..."

I thought we loved each other... Why, Haruki? Why are you casting me down into hell?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: First released in long strip format with one chapter split into three parts.

193275.description:
Enya Valencia, dreaded master of the enchanted Hexenkeep of Morgenda, has a new enemy - the celebrated knight of radiance, Helios. The hatred is mutual, but so is their fate of certain death... unless they meet one condition: they must sleep with each other.

"...Shall we start by kissing, hexenkeeper?"

So begins their spiteful romance - at the pinnacle of carnal affection.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

title.native: この出会いは悪縁に違いないのに
title.romaji: Kono Deai wa Akuen ni Chigainainoni

193276.description:
On her way home from work, college student Chisato encounters a vampire named Niru, who has been stabbed and left unconscious. After "moving from one girl's house to another," Niru is stabbed, and Chisato ends up sheltering her...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime July 2025 issue.

title.native: ヒモ吸血鬼が出ていかない

193277.description:
As the last freshmen at a high school scheduled to close, Narumi and Anzu are asked to make a graduation album.

In contrast to Narumi, who reluctantly enrolled after failing to get into her preferred school and studies obsessively, Anzu has no particular dream and feels out of place, acting hit-or-miss.

These two gradually get to know each other through the graduation album production...

This is a story about the four seasons of girls who are torn between anxiety and hope for the future.

(source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Even If Swallowed By The Spring Light

title.romaji: Haru no Hikari ni Nomarete mo

193278.description:
Sharan, a slave of the Valdek Empire, longs for nothing more than to buy her freedom and return to her homeland. But after a fearsome encounter with the cursed emperor, Julian Vadenberg, she ends up as his personal maid! Now, she has the chance to earn her freedom by using her magic to cure Julian of his curse... if not for the fact that she's surrounded by enemies on all sides at the palace. With such perilous prospects, can she survive long enough to heal the emperor and finally break free?

(Source: Tapas)

193279.description:
Niwa dreams of becoming a world champion in boxing, and Aono supports that dream. The two grew up in similar circumstances and lived side by side. Then, one day, they suddenly become separated. Niwa steps up to get Aono's life back, which was stolen from him. This is a heartbreaking story of friendship torn apart by fate!

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

193280.description:
1-3. Reijou Jigoku (令嬢地獄)
4. Hontou wa Warui Ko (ほんとうはわるいこ)
5-6. Manatsu no Dekigoto (真夏の出来事)
7. Punch Ippatsu Yuutai Ridatsu (パンチ一発ゆーたい離脱)
synonyms: パンチ一発ゆーたい離脱

title.native: 令嬢地獄 聖晃学園集団レイプ事件
title.romaji: Reijou Jigoku: Seiko Gakuen Shuudan Rape Jiken

193281.description:
Game developer Chi Qian was betrayed by her boyfriend while working on a romance mobile game. Amid an argument, she was pushed onto the game server and suddenly found herself transmigrated into the game world as the main antagonist - Queen Catherine, the villain.

Now, Shen Chi Qian must navigate the challenges of seducing the king and avoiding detection by the princess. Desperate to escape the game, she purposely provokes the princess in hopes of meeting a swift demise. However, her plans are foiled by unexpected twists and turns.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: One Day, I Transmigrated Into the Vicious Queen
One Day, I Transmigrated Into the Villainous Queen
某天穿成恶毒皇后（恶毒皇后）

title.english: One Day I Became the Villainous Queen
title.romaji: Mou Tian Chuan Cheng Edu Huanghou

193282.description:
I'm Nozaki Shuhei, a novelist in a slump. I was wondering if something interesting would come up... when, just as I was thinking about it, a beautiful girl suddenly appeared before me! She claims to be an alien who came to rule Earth. "As a thank you for saving me, I'll take your virginity (?)," she says, slamming me with the tentacles growing from her back...♪

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Anthurium 2025-06

193283.description:
In the midst of a turbulent crisis, a catastrophe in the middle of a country that is barely dying. Nine castles were captured in an instant, and among them, there was one with a strong power that surpassed the human category. And people defined them as nine dragons and called them.

Fascinating cartoon characters that surpassed game characters appeared in the back-and-forth victory of FL Mobile Korea.

193284.description:
Hibiki is a junior high school student who supports the idol duo Zukkyun☆! While she was supporting them on social media, she was called by the agency and unexpectedly became a member!?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.native: 推しのためにバズっ！きゅんが〜る☆
title.romaji: Oshi no Tame ni Buzz! Kyun Girl☆

193285.description:
He is the one who brings about the darkness, the "Archer of Dusk." It is through his hard work that night falls peacefully every day.

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title.native: 春夏秋冬代行者 黄昏の射手

193286.description:
Tsumugi, a member of the "Rabbit Tribe," meets Kanae, a member of the "Fox Tribe," their enemy. The Fox Tribe eats the Rabbit Tribe, so they should be enemies, but before they know it, love has blossomed between the two of them...!? A forbidden love story between different species that must be kept a secret from everyone.

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.romaji: Kitsune to Usagi no Moe Yuru Koi

193287.description:
Makoto Higurashi, the daughter of a spy, falls in love at first sight with the refreshing transfer student, Setsu Emori. However, she becomes very anxious when she displays a special ability that is impossible for an ordinary girl to have. Far from being surprised by Makoto, Setsu seems to have realized something...

(Source: Ciao Plus)

title.native: シークレット・ドッグ〜わたしの愛犬ボディーガード〜
title.romaji: Secret Dog: Watashi no Aiken Bodyguard

193288.description:
Futaba, a fifth-grader, has a crush on her childhood friend Takuto, who is three years older than her. But Takuto doesn't pay her any attention, saying she's like a little sister to him. Wanting to get closer to her, she borrows her sister's uniform and sneaks into her junior high school...!?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.native: うそつきオトナチェンジ ！

193289.description:
One night, Byeong-geon experiences sleep paralysis in his new house. He finds a ghost performing oral sex under his blanket but brushes it off, thinking it’s just his exhaustion. The next day, the ghost appears again, this time holding a knife to his dick?! "I'll... cut it off..." He barely manages to soothe and placate the ghost to keep it away, but now his body starts reacting to the ghost's seductive expression...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: アソコは放して言ってくれ〜俺にメンヘラお化けが取り憑いた〜

title.native: パニックバニーハニー

193291.description:
Kira is a little poor, but she's just an ordinary middle school girl. Her dream is to become a model one day☆ Now she has the chance to audition for an exclusive model position at her favorite magazine, "Dreamin'"! But she's surrounded by super tough rivals...!? A model success story that will make everyone's hearts sparkle.

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193292.description:
Fashion is invincible! Kizuna is a girl who dreams of becoming a stylist. She has the mysterious power to hear the voices of clothes! She can't get along with her friends... She can't be honest with the person she likes... She wants to be a girl worthy of the senior she admires...

Kizuna's sense and happy power will solve such problems in a stylish way!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.native: おしゃべりクロゼット

193293.description: Hayase Ryouta, a competitive spirit from the countryside, and his colleague, Issei Tokitou, are head-to-head for the top spot at the company's headquarters. But how can they be considered rivals if Hayase hasn't even won once? On top of that, Tokitou is also the heir to the company-- which makes Hayase's inferiority complex gnaw at him more. On the day of their company's awarding rites, a drunken Hayase, who is being looked after by Tokitou, reveals that he is actually gay. A drunken invite unexpectedly ends with Tokitou being all sweet and devoted in bed....? S high-spec company heir x an employee who hates to lose!

title.native: 恋をするならひれ伏して

193297.description:
One day, I realized I had been reincarnated as the protagonist’s friend in a tragic novel—one where I was doomed to die while trying to save the heroine. Determined to change my fate, I decided to tell the heroine everything… but for some reason, my words were censored, as if the universe itself was blocking spoilers! Frustrated, I stormed into the forbidden forest and shouted my secrets into the void—venting my anger at the male lead while I was at it. It should’ve been fine. No one was supposed to hear me. Yet somehow, rumors spread like wildfire that the powerful Duke Vishvaltz was… into men?! Now, he’s launching a full-blown investigation to find the source of the absurd gossip.

“…Your voice is quite unforgettable.”

…Yep. My life is officially over.

(Source: Lezhin US)

193298.description:
“What will people call him?”

Someone asked. But no one could answer. A transcendent being appeared in the world. Creating a new history in the film industry.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

193299.description:
As an S-Class agent at the top-secret intel firm Vulture, Adrian "Killy" Rosebarton (Codename: Uno) is the master of seduction, able to charm secrets out of literally anyone regardless of age, gender, or profession. But when he sets his sights on his newest target, Lorenzo “Loren” Stefano, things take a rotten turn. No matter how hard he flirts, Loren just won’t bite - and Uno’s pride (and mission) are about to crumble. If one thing is certain, it’s that this is no ordinary mark. This one’s a bad apple: poisonous if swallowed, impossible to spit out, and dangerously tempting.

(Source: Lezhin US)

193300.description:
Su Chen found himself transported into a parallel world where he was part of a cast that included six celebrities that would be appearing for a mystery thriller variety show.
During the show, the cast found themselves being hunted as real fugitives for the production crew of this show wished to show its viewers the thrill and suspense of being pursued.
Watch how Su Chen makes full use of his 144 IQ intelligence and prevail!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Entertainment: 365 Days for the Superstar to Escape

193301.description:
Sun Xian was born under the ominous sign of “Yinghuo,” the Calamity Star.

Her life was forever marked by tragedy— Her parents, manipulated by the mysterious power known as “Imperial Throne”, committed atrocities that led to the deaths of hundreds of thousands.

At just twelve years old, Sun Xian was branded a threat to humanity and imprisoned by a secret organization known as The Dark Zone.

There, she was subjected to horrific experiments— altering her body and mind, and awakening within her a terrifying power: “To slay rulers and destroy thrones.”

Five years later, she uncovers the truth: The Dark Zone doesn’t protect peace. It profits from chaos, and it framed her family to cover its crimes— even driving her parents to suicide.

Enraged, Sun Xian escapes. No longer the child who was caged, she becomes the executioner, bent on vengeance.

In a simulated age of war and collapse, the girl once called a harbinger of doom will become the blade that severs corruption.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

193302.description:
There's a girl called Summer. She has social phobia and is allergic to men. As soon as being crashed by a car, she got one and only chance—the qualification to get the heart of superstar Donggong Shuiyue in a game?!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Ten Thousand Ways to Win the Hearts of Sexy Men

title.english: Ten Thousand Ways to Win Sexy Guys' Hearts
title.native: 攻略妖男的一万种姿势
title.romaji: Gonglue Yao Nande Yi Wan Zhong Zishi

193303.description:
The most cunning war god in the universe ✖ The most paranoid elite in the universe

Wherever you are, I will be there, without rest or discouragement. ——Shooting Star

(Source: Tencent, translated)

193305.description:
Luo Yunqi gets stuck in a historical novel as an abandoned wife. With her magical supermarket cheat, she plans to make bank and disappear. But her survival system binds her to her mortal enemy. Now she has to bribe the empire's coldest official with snacks just to stay alive. But this move accidentally turns the ruthless male lead into a clingy puppy who just won't let her go. Facing red wedding candles and locked doors, Yunqi throws the script aside and yells, "We agreed on going our separate ways! But this guy's totally off-script!"

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I Took the Supermarket to Ancient Times to Raise a Prime Minister
I Brought a Supermarket to Ancient Times to Raise a Prime Minister

title.english: I Bring A Mart to Feed My Ministerial Husband
title.native: 我带超市穿到古代养丞相
title.romaji: Wo Dai Chaoshi Chuan Dao Gudai Yang Chengxiang
Omae no Onna wa Ore no Onna

193309.description:
The village of Sacri is a fertile oasis on the otherwise barren frontier. But Sacri's prosperity comes at a steep price! The ruling noble, an immortal vampire princess, feasts on the villagers at her whim. When a young man attempts to save his lover from being bitten, the princess sends her four savage knights to punish the petulant villagers. Standing in their way is none other than the beautiful and dangerous Vampire Hunter D! With the help of a rebellious young woman named Elena, D undertakes a quest to end the princess's deadly rule. But first, the two of them will risk their lives in an epic duel with her knights.

(Sources: Dark Horse Comics)
synonyms: Vampire Hunter D: The Rose Princess

title.native: 吸血鬼ハンターD 薔薇姫
この私がち〇ぽが立派なだけが取り柄の落ちこぼれ若様なんかに堕とされる訳がありません。
title.romaji: Kono Watashi ga Chinpo ga Rippa na dake ga Torie no Ochikobore Waka-sama Nanka ni Otosareru Wake ga Arimasen.

193311.description:
Akira Inaba, a sophomore, is a candidate for the next student council president thanks to his irreproachable conduct and great academic achievements. He's highly trusted by his teachers and adored by his classmates alike for his bright and friendly personality. However, he also had a serious problem...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Troubles of an Honor Student

193312.description:
Eun-Su's prescient dreams show him an apocalypse which is confirmed by his awaking powers. To survive, he bonds with Jae-Young, a hidden powerhouse and seemingly guaranteed survivor. As monsters invade and the world unravels with gods, betrayal, and chaos, they must fight to stay alive—together.

(Source: Manta, edited)

193313.description:
Dan-Ryeong loves the young prince who follows him around and idolizes him to the point of death, but on the outside, he is cold and strict with him and tries to fulfill his duty as a teacher. Then one day, things go wrong when a friend drugs Dan-Ryeong, puts a hood on him, and sends him to the prince's bedroom.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: À la douceur de la brise

193314.description:
Hae-Sung, who was about to lose everything and make an extreme choice, is taken in by Da-Kyung. As Da-Kyung's possession, Hae-Sung becomes a host who lives solely on physical instincts and money. Will he be able to find hope even in this hell...?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193315.description:
Guard Kang Yu-Jin with immeasurable abilities pretends to be a zero with no abilities and manufactures guard drugs at a pharmaceutical company. He tries to live a normal, quiet life as an office worker... but he is in danger of being exposed as a guard due to the sudden appearance of the pretty crazy S-class psychic Daniel Miller.

Please... let me fire him!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

193316.description:
Min Woo-Ri, the representative 'shit car collector' of the film department at Korea University. No more dating! Tired of relationships that always end bitterly, Woo-Ri decides to focus on her graduation project, saying that money and fame are more important than men. 'No matter how lonely you are, don't think about meeting anyone. Unless you want to die because of that guy at graduation.' However, a mysterious text message soon arrives to Woo-ri. It contains an ominous prophecy that the man she will date in the future will be a great threat to her...

It's hard to think of it as a simple prank text message because the text message really starts to match events that happen in real life one by one. And soon after receiving the text message, three men keep getting involved with her as if it were a lie. Which of these men will become her future boyfriend?

Woo-ri's eventful journey to find a boyfriend is given the chance to stop 'the worst shit car in life.'

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

193317.description:
"Please divorce me, my lord."

At the Valery manor, the count Lord Frederick is enamored by his mistress, whose whims dictate where his finances go. Unsurprisingly, his servants begin to leave one after another, refusing to become collateral damage. Meanwhile, the count's wife Liese enlists the help of the chancellor Lord Alwin so she may finally save enough money to escape her hellhole of a marriage!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: Three years after the marriage blanc. My husband, please divorce me!

title.english: Three Years After the Mariage Blanc: My Lord, Please Divorce Me!
title.native: 白い結婚から三年。旦那様、私と離縁してください
title.romaji: Shiroi Kekkon kara Sannen. Danna-sama, Watashi to Rien shite Kudasai

193318.description:
"If you live a shitty life, you'll end up with a shitty movie." Ryuji and Ryukichi, who live in a suffocating countryside in the early Heisei era, had a dream. To become an actor and a film director - that was their dream. However, perhaps because of his parents or the world around him, Ryuji becomes a yakuza. Just when things were starting to go wrong, Ryukichi suggests that the two of them make a movie. The story is about Ryuji's life as a yakuza. They'll put his whole life into a movie and present it to the shitty world. It's a once-in-a-lifetime performance for just the two of them.

(Source: YanMaga Web, translated)

193319.description:
He's the ultimate alpha male—the face of Korea’s best-selling male supplement, flying off the shelves every second. To Suyeon, he's nothing more than an annoying boss… until she discovers the one secret he never wanted anyone to know. Is the romance between a man who thinks he's perfect and the woman who can't stand him destined to spiral out of control?

(Source: Manta)

title.native: 勇者パーティを追放されかけたぼくが魔王討伐に大貢献しました
title.romaji: Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sarekaketa Boku ga Maou Toubatsu ni Dai Kouken Shimashita

193321.description:
A girl named Yuki discovers a mysterious watch that stops time—and uses it to save a boy, Hiroki, from certain death. Drawn together by the secret of the clock, the two find themselves bound by an unforgettable summer. In a world frozen in time, an unprecedented suspenseful romance begins!

(Source: Manga Plus)

193322.description:
Tender-hearted Jerenia is married to the most uncaring and disrespectful husband, Vincent Mercier. Her in-laws undermine and abuse her daily, but Jerenia believes that if she bears a child, she could be respected as part of the dukedom. After trying for seven years, she finally conceives a child, only to find out that Vincent's been cheating on her with her childhood friend, Erica. Vincent conspires to kill his wife, but surviving the murder attempt has turned Jerenia into a woman of vengeance.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

title.native: 裏切られた令嬢の完璧な復讐計画
title.romaji: Uragirareta Reijou no Kanpekina Fukushuu Keikaku

193323.description:
In a world where gamers are the elite, Ryuhwi is an unknown, the lowest caste of society. Yet it hasn't always been this way... After years of working as a dedicated analyst for a top gaming guild, he was framed and saw his entire life fall apart. But one day, he's given a second chance by a mysterious (and kinda cute) machine claiming to be the system itself. With the odds now in his favor, he's determined to take revenge on all those who wronged him and uproot this corrupt society!

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: ガチャ王〜神のゲーマー〜

synonyms: Shin Majin Den Battle Royal High School (真魔神伝 バトルロイヤルハイスクール)

193325.description:
We are members of a brass band! Practicing hard every day hoping to go to Nationals!

(Source: Shonen Jump, translated)

Note: The debut work of Hideo Shinkai, originally published in Akamaru Jump 2004 Summer issue.

193326.description:
Hey! Can you not look at me like I’m your food? Alright alright I’m sorry okay? Don’t come closer! And don’t lick me!!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: This Vampire Is a Bit Cute

title.romaji: Zhe Ge Xuezu You Dian Meng

193327.description:
Ban Yeon-Ha, troubled by debts, makes a proposal to her boss and long-time hidden crush.

"You need a woman who will take your money, give you a child, and won't complain or expect too much. How about me?"

Seo Gang-Hyeon, a man who does not believe in a woman's sweet words, sneers at his young secretary.

"Are you sure you can accept my conditions?"
"Yes, but the money… I want it when I deliver the child."
"All of it?"
"Yes… to pay off my debts."

She was hoping to finally cast off the shackles that have bound her all her life. But Seo Gang-Hyeon has other ideas.

"Am I some sort of cuck? Give money to the mother of my child only for her to fly away?"

The old Seo Gang-Hyeon might not have cared, but there's no way Gang-Hyeon will let her go now.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

193328.description:
Thanks for getting back to me, I've just gotten back to the sect on their flying sword. Like, have you ever seen the sun rising at 6am in a fantasy world? Don't forget you're in another world! In this world of cultivation, the people are poor and desperate, and danger lurks around every corner. Don't forget you're just an ordinary guy, with no talent for cultivation at all. But… he's got his smartphone with him, and it's still connected to the Internet… And so he made a new forum post, "How the heck do you survive when you've been isekai-ed into a dangerous world of immortal cultivation?"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: Traveling Through the World of Cultivation, But Being Able to Connect to the Internet
title.native: 穿越修真世界，但是可以联网
title.romaji: Chuan Yue Xiuzhen Shijie, Dan Shi Ke Yi Lian Wang

193329.description:
The promiscuous playboy is reborn back to the day before he died while "doing four guys in one day." Trying to survive this time, he leaves breakup letters for them and runs away instead. However, his exes all comes looking for him, trying to get him back. Looking for help, he sought shelter with the local "big-shot," but even that guy is starting to look at him with an increasingly smoldering eye, too?! Even a playboy is at a loss for what to do. How does he deal with all these boyfriends?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Playboy Repents and is Reborn into a Complicated Relationship with Five People
The Playboy Has Reformed After Falling Into Five Equal Love Complex

title.native: 海王从良后陷入了五等分修罗场
title.romaji: Haiwang Cong Liang Hou Xian Ru Le Wudengfen Xiuluochang

193332.description:
Tomo and Hayami have been childhood friends since elementary school. Despite their contrasting roles - one a part-time worker and the other an elite trading company employee - their relationship remains as comfortable as it was during their school days.

One day, Tomo witnesses his girlfriend exiting a love hotel with Hayami. Feeling betrayed by his girlfriend's actions, Tomo confronts Hayami outside his house. The revelation that follows is nothing short of shocking.

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title.native: 愛してるから嵌めさせて

193333.description:
A shy bride who was called "useless" and a cursed, fluffy prince fall in love!

The Norstalt family were known for their superpowers. However, Elena was born with no power at all. Her mother adored her, but passed away when Elena was young. She was treated cruelly by her family as a "useless girl" and when she turned seventeen, she was ordered by her father to marry Yuri, the cursed second prince of Lodenium. The bride was supposed to be Vanessa, her younger sister who was blessed with fire power, but their father decided to offer Elena instead. When she reached the palace of Lodenium, she was told that prince won't come until the night of the Full Moon. It first bothered her, but people around her were all kind and gentle, and Elena started to enjoy living in the palace. Then she met a strange big wolf in the garden...

(Source: Kadokawa, edited)

title.english: The True Value of the Throwaway Bride

title.romaji: Ore ga Kawari ni Succubus Yatteyaru!!

193335.description:
Samaritan High is infamous for its many delinquent students. At first glance, Kawai, Mori, and Tanikura fit the bad boy image—but wait... is that one of them rescuing a stray chihuahua? Whether it’s soothing crying children or spreading cheer around the neighborhood, these so-called bad boys are actually striving to do good! A wholesome slice-of-life comedy about a group of unexpectedly dependable "delinquents"!

(Source: Manga Up! Global)

title.native: 善良な不良高校生の日常
title.romaji: Zenryou na Furyou Koukousei no Nichijou

193336.description:
"Sir, please bless me with your superior baby seeds❤️"

He had clawed his way up from nothing, building a kingdom in his dusty hometown without any help from his parents. Having lived so fiercely, he left his company to his sons, in hopes to spend the rest of his life in peace. However, his naughty daughters-in-law were not going to leave him alone- not his dick at least.

(Source: DAYcomics)

193338.description:
A modern person named You You transmigrates into the world of cultivation, where women are born noble and hold a higher status than men. Among many women, heavenly maidens who can activate people’s spiritual roots and achieve immortality descend upon the world. You You becomes one of these rare heavenly maidens and takes on the responsibility of founding the Zhenyan Sect. She leads the entire sect as they fight monsters, level up, and embark on a path of growth, all the while seeking her significant other along the way.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: 女尊每天都在被美男迫害

193339.description:
Abandoned as an infant, Yongsheng has always been an outsider. When his peaceful existence is shattered, he's thrust into a world of shadows and secrets. Armed with newfound abilities and guided by a mysterious mentor, he joins a clandestine organization known as the Nie Slayers. As he uncovers the truth about his past and the forces that threaten humanity, Yongsheng must decide how far he is willing to go to protect those he loves.

(Source: Webnovel)

193340.description:
Amidst the chaos of a shattered life, Yu Zhou faces a crisis: discouragement that threatens her career as a writer. Everything seems to be falling apart — until an unexpected encounter changes her course. Xiang Wan, a mysterious and resilient woman who claims to have traveled back in time from Imperial China, appears in her life as a breath of hope.

With her ancestral courage and peculiar vision of the modern world, she helps Yu Zhou find the strength to move forward. However, fate has another surprise in store: Yu Zhou's literary work is adapted into an audio drama, and the protagonist chosen to give voice to the story is none other than Su Chang, her ex-girlfriend. The reunion of the two rekindles dormant memories and feelings, creating a delicate emotional triangle.

193341.description:
Joo-Ho, who became human from an abandoned zoo tiger; Hee-Heon, who possesses a mystical power that turned Joo-Ho into a human; the two who spent their childhood together like brothers are separated due to Hee-Heon's mistake. Then one day, 10 years later, Joo-Ho receives an urgent call from Hee-Heon.

"We need to meet right now. The spell is wearing off."

The two meet again. There, Joo-Ho hears a rather shocking method to reinforce the spell.

"You have to... do it with me for 100 days."

Will Joo-Ho be able to survive the 100 days like this and become a whole person?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193342.description:
Claren, the half-breed princess of the barbarians. She has been weak since childhood and cannot walk, so she is ignored even by her servants, and is eventually abandoned by her family during the war with the barbarian nation of Kailom. In revenge, she handed over the entire royal family to Kailom, and was given a title in recognition of her achievements. When Claren raised her head with the king's permission, Dean, the runaway slave, was standing there.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193343.description:
Yeon-geon Baek has harbored a crush on his best friend, Eihwa Yoon, for years, but he’s finally had enough rejection. Determined to get away, he starts planning his leave to study abroad. He’s spent too many years hiding behind castle walls built of secrets. However, the more he tries to distance himself, the more his secrets are pulled out into the open.
Maybe when it’s over, things will be better, and maybe… he’ll be able to have what he’s always wanted.

(Source: Tapas)

193344.description:
Kwon Jiwu is a top actor blessed with perfect looks and talent, but there’s one strange problem: every male animal seems to be in love with him. After yet another chaotic day on set fending off animal admirers, he’s ready to snap when his cheeky junior co-star Ju Yeongwon starts picking a fight. Just as Jiwu is about to put him in his place, something catches his eye. Cat ears? Wait a second, was Yeongwon one of those “male animals” all along?

(Source: Lezhin US)

193345.description:
Jeong Na-Woon, a natural born gold digger and a man who fantasizes about even the smallest favor, ends up having an affair with Kyeong-Ha, whom he has had a crush on since childhood, while drunk. Although it was a drunken affair, Na-Woon thinks that the temperature and humidity that day were perfect, and now all that's left is to marry Kyeong-Ha, so he's in a happy mood... But contrary to Na-Woon's plans for a happy future, Kyeong-Ha says they should pretend it never happened...?

"To you, hyung, I was really... just a dildo shuttle?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

193346.description:
A comical, twisted, parenting romance that requires a miracle!

A reclusive loner, social misfit, avoidant personality disorder, and best novelist 'Gong-Jeong' is faced with newborn twins?! What a bolt from the blue! Before Gong-Jeong can even blame his mother for leaving the twins behind, he has to deal with the newborns who cry loudly! Gong-Jeong, who is at a loss and hesitating, is helped by his editor friend, Boo Seung-Hyun, who finds a babysitter. That's how 'Igi-Jeok', the god of parenting, appears. Can Gong-Jeong, who hates people so much, team up with Igi-Jeok to raise newborn twins?

A twisted and tumultuous parenting romance where two people who met as fate when they were young raise twins together and establish new understandings about life, life, and human relationships!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

193349.description:
Jay, the protagonist, is influenced by the donor's memories and habits after a heart transplant. He coincidentally meets Arthur, the donor's ex-lover and a member of a criminal organization, and gets involved in the underworld. He can only return home if he remembers where the items stolen by Owen, the heart donor, are located... A rival organization constantly engages in sabotage and a series of incidents and accidents ensue. Jay and Arthur gradually become closer as they overcome crises together. Will the two be able to return to their daily lives safely?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193350.description:
Lapis fled to Earth during the planetary war, and without anyone to help him, he was on the verge of collapse when Do-Yul appeared. Lapis fell in love with him at first sight and went back to space and won. Lapis returned to Earth under the pretext of breeding his species and sought out his first love, Do-Yul. Will his first love come true?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

193351.description:
Hyo-Jin, a rabbit, takes in Ji-Ha, a black panther, who was abandoned, and raises him like his own younger sibling. Ji-Ha, who grew up quickly, confesses his love to Hyo-Jin every day as soon as he becomes an adult, but Hyo-Jin rejects his confessions every day. Then one day, Hyo-Jin goes into heat for which he was not prepared for, and Ji-Ha offers to help Hyo-Jin, who doesn't know what to do...

"I'm an adult now. I'll help you."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: พี่กระต่ายที่รัก

193352.description:
The long-awaited virtual reality fantasy game has been released!

The last man of Joseon, aka Jomaja, Boryeong, dreams of doing all sorts of things he can't do in reality, so much so that he even bought an adult expansion pack, But what the heck?! [Job: Barmaid] He finished his first job advancement without even a tutorial?! So what will he become? A seductive male prostitute who will rock the world. I was confused for a moment, wondering if it was a mistake.This really suits me?! It's a fantasy world filled with NPCs who are no different from electronic dildos anyway, so what's the problem with showing off some hidden talents?

Play a virtual reality game filled with lewd desires! [Would you like to start?]

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193353.description:
"What would it feel like to be surrounded by muscles and have your bare skin pressed against me?"

Since I was young, I've preferred to spend time alone in my room. Unlike my friends who have just become adults and are busy going to clubs, going out, and having fun. However, of course, being an introvert doesn't mean I don't have desires. That's right. My taste was to have sex with several people at once. On the premise that they were good-looking men! I enjoyed sending dirty jokes through messages on the Internet, a dream that I couldn't achieve in reality. This life of hiding behind anonymity and enjoying it alone was so perfect...

"If I knew you were going to reveal it like this, we would've done it for you a long time."
"That's what I'm saying. We didn't have to fight among ourselves."
"No way...!"
"So, you did a lot of it alone while watching your oppas?"

I was wondering what kind of crazy people they were to send me pictures with such big things on their bodies, and it turned out they were my brother's friends who had been bothering me the other day!!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

193354.description:
Choi, a nurse practicing at a mental hospital, witnesses a patient pretending to be a doctor while she was working an ordinary job. The strange patient, who was strangely interested in her, disappears before her eyes after saying that he will give her a discharge gift, and Choi's boss who had been harassing her ends up in a terrible situation...

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

193355.description:
In a world where yokai once clashed with gods and humans, Joo Hwang, a 22-year-old with no skills except seeing ghosts, lands a job at Oddity Office. Tasked with reviewing souls for reincarnation, she soon learns the spirit world is far stranger than she imagined.

(Source: Toomics)

193356.description:
On the summit of a lofty mountain where winged birds soar, the Old Man of the South Pole and Dongfang Shuo play Go. Shuo, pondering the origins of the universe, learns from the Old Man that long ago, when the heavens nearly collapsed, a goddess kneaded five-colored stones to seal the celestial rift. Yet since this occurred in distant antiquity, they journey to seek guidance from the ancient god of Mount Tianqiong, the Faceless One, also known as Chaos. However, the Faceless One, who had never moved since the creation of heaven and earth, became intrigued by their conversation. He took interest in the world below and set off for the surface through the Immortal Corridor...

(Source: Ushio Publishing, translated)

- Chapter count includes two additional one-shots.

193357.description: Ayumu Otsuki is a space lover with an ambitious dream—to meet an alien. Lacking friends or romantic experience, she starts an Astronomy Club by herself, to create a place where she feels she belongs. One day after school, she was putting up a poster to advertise the club when an upperclassman stepped in to help. The upperclassman introduces herself as Hayami, and Ayumu immediately falls in love at first sight with her! Ayumu's mind is now consumed by romance, and she goes all out to share her feelings. However, Senpai seems to already have other interests. She fell for a fitness junkie?! A peculiar girl's straightforward romcom!!

193358.description:
Armed with the mystical Linglong Tower in one hand and a super-charged palm in the other, our protagonist dominates the urban landscape, capturing demons and subduing spirits. Whether it’s a slit-mouthed woman, a cat-faced girl, or a ghostly figure in white—no supernatural entity stands a chance against his command!

(Source: Webnovel)

193361.description:
Once a powerful and kind sorceress, Sera's life is turned upside down when she is betrayed and cursed, causing her magic to turn dark and twisted. Forced into the role of a villain, Sera must navigate a treacherous world filled with enemies and scarce allies. As she battles her inner demons and external threats, Sera discovers that embracing her darker side may be the only way to reclaim her destiny and uncover the truth behind her curse. Join Sera on her journey of transformation, betrayal, and redemption in this captivating manhua.

(Source: Webnovel)

193362.description:
Games of love and lust play out between men and women under the bright lights of the big city. The women who call themselves "the devil squad" are vigilantes who punish the scumbags guys who prey on women beyond the reach of law. As "the devil squad" becomes increasingly famous, its founder Lin Mo takes on legendary status among the women of the city. But beneath the tumultuous waves, what kind of dark mystery hides her true face?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: やさしさが目にしみる

193364.description:
In this world of beast summoners, the Kingdom of Xia was weakened due to their lack of powerful summoners, having lost their cultural history. Until Yang Yang transmigrated into this world with the powerful manual known as Shanghaijing, and now all the legendary beasts of the seas and mountains are his to command! With terrifying power and skill, he will lead the Xia to sweep across the globe and crush every nation in his way. Amazed by his power, people realized that he is not just an ordinary beast tamer, but the heaven-conquering "Beast Master"!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Before meeting Dong Li, Song Jingyan wanted a hardworking man with a car, a house, and well-built body. Once she met Dong Li, there was only one thought on her mind — how to bed Dong Li!

(Source: Webnovel)

193366.description:
When a mysterious explosion destroys an insane asylum, the Chief Director of asylum Yun Zhonghe is transmigrated to another world, with the memories of 29 mad genius inmates in his head. With those 29 unique skills, he joins the secret service in his new world and goes undercover as a spy in the enemy kingdom. Three years passes, then three more, and he finds himself in the position of consort to the enemy Empress, and she wants to have children with him!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

193370.description:
There's nothing that people like more than cute animals! Is Inukai-san, the mysterious woman who appears before the lost new zookeeper, the savior of the zoo, or just a suspicious person?

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

193371.description:
"If it means that I can read your work again, I'll even chase you to the ends of the earth."

Seri Tainaka, writing under the pen name Nanakusa, is a mid-career manga artist living in the shadow of her only one-hit-wonder. Her series "To Hell and Back" was adored by fans, but despite now being a ten-year veteran, her successes ended there. So when Seri is told that she is being assigned a new editor, it only fuels her insecurities. When Seri meets the quirky Sumire Futami, she's both creeped out and captivated by the strange and overly forthright woman, who claims she'd go to hell and back to make her a success again. But just when Seri starts to think she and Futami might be an unstoppable duo, she meets the other manga artists Futami is assigned to, and a dangerous game of jealousy, envy, and femme fatales begins. It turns out that Futami has no qualms about going back and forth between which of her artists capture her attention the most, and they'll stop at nothing to win the number one spot in their fickle editor's heart!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

synonyms: The Male Lead Knelt Before Me
I Brought the Male Lead to His Knees Before Me

193375.description:
At the age of 8, Anya Lockhart realizes she's been born into a tragic dark romance novel she read in her past life. And unfortunately, she's the female lead destined to fall into the crazy emperor's clutches! So when his proposal arrives, she packs up and runs away from home. After years on the run, she meets Dale, a sweet mercenary living in a remote southern village. But is there more to Dale than meets the eye? The more she learns, the more he doesn't seem like an ordinary mercenary...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: My Contract Husband Resembles the Male Protagonist

title.english: My Contract Husband Looks Like the Male Lead

193376.description:
Eveness wakes up as the wicked princess of a novel who's doomed to die on her wedding day. Determined to change her destiny, she rebuilds her reputation and convinces her cold fiancé Grand Duke Terence Lenz into a partnership to prevent this impending peril. However, as she alters the story, unexpected twists arise—Terence’s hatred turns to passionate love, and new dangers loom. Can Eveness navigate this altered fate and find true happiness, or will the unknown challenges consume her?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Survive as a Villain on the Verge of Death

193377.description:
For the past four years, Hye-Yeong has been juggling three jobs to pay off her father’s debt, all while single-handedly caring for her younger sister—never missing a single payment. But just as she’s on the verge of finally breaking free, her life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with Ji Joo-Chan, the enigmatic executive director of Shinwon Finance.

Is her luck finally about to change? Or will she be dragged into his dark world instead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

193378.description:
Pil-Sang ends up living with Joo-Eon to treat the side effects of Sianacin. Joo-Eon, whose true intentions are unknown, secretly takes care of and protects Pil-Sang, even though no one knows what he's thinking. When asked, "Do you like me?", Joo-Eon tells him to say something reasonable and laughs until he's out of breath, but he doesn't tolerate Pil-Sang leaving his side even an inch. Then one day, he becomes unexpectedly affectionate. He wonders, "What on earth is he doing?" but a strange emotion blooms somewhere in Pil-Sang's heart...

What will be the end of this fierce battle of cohabitation between Joo-Eon, the chairman who was born with a diamond spoon in his mouth, and Pil-Sang, a loan shark who lives at the bottom?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193379.description:
After crashing her ex's wedding, high school teacher Si-Yeon drowns her heartbreak in a hotel bar, only to end up in a reckless one-night stand with a charming young man. Although she’s ready to forget the night ever happened, she's thrown into chaos when he appears at her school as her new coworker. As if that wasn't bad enough, he turns out to be Ha-Jun, a former student she taught years ago. While Si-Yeon struggles to keep her walls up, Ha-Jun boldly closes the distance, refusing to let their past—or their night together—stay buried.

(Source: Tappytoon)

193384.description:
Meet your perfect ideal type in the game!

Ji-Hyeong is trapped in the fantasy game 'EROS' developed by a friend. When Ji-Hyeong can only return to reality after seeing the ending due to a bug, the game distributor team leader Hyun-Woo enters the game to help. Ji-Hyeong feels excited seeing Hyun-Woo, who is such a perfect ideal type. There is no progress in the game due to their mysterious relationship, and to make matters worse, Ji-Hyeong meets a game character who looks exactly like Se-Jun, who hurt him deeply...

Will they be able to successfully clear the game and escape?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
synonyms: It's My First Time Doing This Episode!

193385.description:
Scholar Dae-Ho is smart enough to grow up being called a prodigy, but because of his kind nature, he fails the civil service exam every time. Every time he helps people in need who appear in front of him on his way to the exam site, he fails even his 10th exam... This time, he is determined to take the exam and pass, but a strange thing appears in front of Dae-Ho and makes a secret offer.

"No matter what happens, I will make sure that you enter the exam site. So, show me what it's like to be the widow next door."

Dae-Ho hesitates, saying that he can't do it, but the strange thing whispers to Dae-Ho that Hong-Ju, a poor widow who has had four husbands before even having her first night, also wants a man's hand...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of RIDI's Seonbi Danpyeonseon (선비 단편선) Collection.

193386.description:
Recently, rumors have been circulating that the nuns are being seduced by the demon. Isabella, who has been living a devout life of faith, has never had difficulty maintaining her chastity until she became a nun, so she considers those who are swayed by the demon’s temptation foolish. However, the demon notices the desire hidden deep inside Isabella. That night, Isabella’s fellow nun Marianne suddenly comes to visit and confesses her feelings and kisses Isabella. Isabella, for some reason, cannot push Marianne away…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

The story is a slightly erotic love comedy about Noa Inukubo, a high school girl who wants to be perfect, and Tamaki, a junior girl who has a crush on her. One day, Tamaki, who desperately wants to have sex, casts a certain spell on Noa. Noa loses control of her sexual desire, and Tamaki grows a male organ. In order to break the spell, the two must have sex. However, Tamaki has lost her sexual desire... The story follows the two as they grow closer and try to help Tamaki regain her sexual desire and break the spell.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

A complex, hard-boiled tale of a romance-drama scriptwriter and a stoic gangster. Ushio Oyamada, a scriptwriter in her 30's who is in a bit of a romantic comedy slump, falls in love with someone she's destined to be with while doing research for a drama that could be her comeback...!?

193392.description:
A large man in the dark sky. A demon. Something in the shape of a bat. He was feared and worshipped by everyone for a long time, but now no one remembers him. He has been forgotten. But he still exists and watches over us. Today, twenty years after Baekjungnal, the long-awaited sacrifice of "him" is finally offered.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193393.description:
San Francisco, early 20th century. Relying on a single photograph, some women crossed the ocean to marry husbands they had never met. Chizuru, who works as a teacher, is one of them. Her husband, Yoshiaki, lives in a free and equal society, with progressive ideas, and respects her. Chizuru had high hopes for a life married to him, but when she met Yoshiaki in America, he was a completely different person to the one in the photograph... A love story that begins with marriage, where the two grow to love each other despite their differences in a place far from their homeland.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

193394.description:
The 'Horang Sansinje' is the biggest (festival) held every 10 years in a shaman family. The Horang Sansinje, where human sacrifices have been practiced since ancient times, used to decorate a bridal chamber, or 'Sanshinbu's Room', to offer a fake bride to the Sansin and marry him off. 'Na-Ri' secretly enters the bridal chamber without the adults knowing and spends a night there. 10 years later... A man with a strange vibe appears in front of Na-Ri, who is very drunk, at a freshman welcome party.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193395.description:
"Kou-ka" is a phenomenon where humans transfer their brains into mechanical vessels and enjoy a second life. In a world where Kou-ka has become the norm, high school girl Makoto Sengoku, who lives with her Kou-ka father, is unable to accept the situation. One day, a mysterious woman appears before Makoto. She says that Makoto's father's brain has been replaced with an artificial intelligence, and that she has come to place his original brain in the vessel. Makoto, who has always had doubts about Kou-ka, decides to follow her, despite being skeptical...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

"I'm gay, so get out."

Ha-Jeong meets Do-Young, a senior he met during a group project, and while enjoying the university festival together, he realizes for sure that he likes him. However, when the impromptu meeting is about to start, Do-Young suddenly comes out to him...?

A young man named Nijimaru, who has just lost his grandmother, is recognized for his natural "grandchild power" and makes his debut at La Vie en Rose, but...? However, Ji-Hyeok, the band leader, is immediately attracted to the vocalist Myo-Jin and scouts him even though he is an alpha. Myo-Jin acts arrogantly, even dragging his omega partner into the band, but Ji-Hyeok kicks out his omega and offers to be his rut ​​partner…

She thought it would be difficult to deal with this cold star, but to her surprise, he turned out to be the cute cat sleeping with her every day! What will happen between this lucky girl and this cat star from another planet? Let's wait and see.

193404.description:
Kouta, an elementary school student who was isolated from his classmates due to his violent behavior, lost his temper one night in the mountains behind his school and threw a stone at a bird. The bird then appeared as a boy and declared that it would take "revenge" on Kouta. In exchange for throwing the stone, Kouta was forced to promise to "do whatever the bird says," and so he went to see the "bird" every night.

On the way home after being crushed at a group date, she reunites with Ryuujin, who was a sparkling presence in high school, and is saved by him when she is being harassed by a man. Maika, who once had a crush on him, sleeps with Ryuujin under the influence of alcohol and they start living together! Then she finds out that Ryujin is unemployed...?

Having lived in poverty all his life, Brian gets a second chance when he is offered the role of the sole heir to a conglomerate family's enormous fortune.

193416.description:
After six short, measly lives as insignificant items of a novel, Florine finally wakes up in the body of a shapeshifter. The problem? She's a tiny sable without enough power to turn into a human. While spending her days as a servant, she crosses paths with Kiraxus, the original novel's villain. She thinks her short life as a shapeshifter is over, but instead, he makes her the daughter-in-law of his family! Will Florine finally live the long life she desires? Or is it all too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas)

193417.description:
The transmigration that happened to others happened to me, too. I’m pretty sure I’m now a supporting character… but exactly which novel is this? When I opened my eyes, I was a widow with stepdaughters my own age, and not only that, I turned into a black swan every night due to a dark curse! Holding back my tears, I decided to take charge of my fate…wait, why should I? Why So Serious? A duchess during the day, a queen of the lake during the night – I have the best luck to be able to leisurely float around! Life should be lived unplanned! When I had just about decided to live my life like this, a white baby swan, one that was not in my no-plan life plan, came to me.

“Mommy, are you really my mommy?”

What, you were a person? And even the youngest sibling of the tyrant emperor?

“I’m not your mother! Can’t you tell by the different colors of our feathers?”

I’m a black swan, you’re a white swan! But why is she so crazy cute. Can our mother-daughter love endure the obsession and persecution of this child’s seven brothers, including the tyrant emperors?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Black Swan Mother of the White Swan Princess

193418.description:
A world where there are "superpowers," a new race of humans who surpass human abilities, and "guides" who can control their rampage. Betty, a guide, hides her identity and lives in a small town in America. One day, James, a super-powered hero, transfers to Betty's school to find the villain "Dave." Betty avoids James but continues to become involved with him. And to make matters worse, while trying to stop her best friend's rampage of superpowers, she is forced to use her guide abilities... It turns out that her friend is not an ordinary superpower, but a villain. It was Dave! Betty is caught between a villain and a hero, and her life, which she wanted to live normally, begins to spiral.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: ヴィランの正義は計り知れない

193419.description:
1. Kawaii Hito (かわいいひと, My Sweet Guy)
2. Kawaikunai Hito (かわいくないひと, My Not-So-Sweet Guy)
3. Hi no Ataru Niwa (陽のあたる庭, A Garden in the Sun)
The garden was filled with fond memories of her childhood spent with her beloved brother... That feeling she experienced was love... As Hibiki wallows in her pain, Sugizo, the happy-go-lucky gardener, enters her life. Despite his traditional name, he's an easy-going guy. Although she's turned off at first, Hibiki starts to realize that each time she touches his heart, her stubbornness seems to melt away... "Is it okay for me... to fall in love again?" A jewel of a love story that will gently warm your heart.

(Source: Renta!)

The two selves of one human being come face to face with each other.

193421.description:
“I shouldn’t have confessed.”

Eun-Ju, an ordinary office worker, is caught by her new subordinate, Lee-Jun, trying to confess to her long-time crush on the team leader. Eun-Ju, who wants to clear up the misunderstanding, also reveals that she can’t confess…!

“Manager, can I tell you a secret of mine to be fair?”

The story of us who fail to confess.

(Source: Naver, translated)

193422.description:
Yeon-Woo, who has been living an ordinary life like flowing water, breaks up with her long-time lover Tae-Ju and meets her first love Se-Jin. But before she can feel the excitement she had forgotten, she suddenly returns to being a high school student…!? Since she knows that her shining first love and the end of a long-term relationship are both meaningless, she has no expectations for love!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two side story chapters.

193423.description:
Humanity suddenly falls into a winter hibernation for an unknown reason. In order to minimize social losses, a "hibernation period" of humanity occurs where everyone hibernates and wakes up. Seo-Woo, who does not hibernate, spends the hibernation period every year with people like himself. And hibernation as usual. This time, something is different. While people are sleeping, strange things are happening.

(Source: Naver, translated)

193424.description:
The Grand Duke who rules the North, Lawrence Celet. A beautiful young man named Luke who doesn't fit in with the North comes to visit him. Luke introduces himself as the 'Administrator'. However, this is the territory managed by Laurence. What on earth does this young man manage?

"A possessed person."
"I am the Administrator who came to save you who was possessed by this BL game."

Lawrence Celet, who fell into the 2-on-1-offense Academy BL game, intuitively feels that he cannot postpone his choice now that the Administrator has arrived. An inevitable ending. And the Grand Duke's choice. Who will the Northern Grand Duke pick?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Shigemi Kusamura is a popular VTuber with 1.3 million subscribers. Her oldest fan, Nanashino, is happy for her success, but can't help but feel a little lonely thinking she has grown distant. However, Shigemi's affection for Nanashino never faded away. In fact, she still replies to every one of his comments, her feelings more intense than ever. What happens when your favorite VTuber turns around and makes you HER favorite?! A virtual rom-com about two people who idolize each other!

While helping at his grandfather's embroidery shop, Tsumugu meets Gina, a girl wearing a biker gang outfit, who asks him to embroider some kanji characters on her jacket for good money. Although Tsumugu is skilled at embroidery, he would rather make fancy scenes rather than embroider boring kanji characters. But through Gina's love for kanji and Japanese culture, Tsumugu starts to see things differently…

193430.description:
Zou Yuan is an ordinary high school boy who lives alone and leads a peaceful life. One day, he suddenly receives a huge parcel, which contained a crystal cabinet, and inside the cabinet was a beautiful girl! The girl's name is Xue Ye, and she comes from the future. The Earth in 2398 AD is a world devastated by nuclear war. The survivors of the nuclear war lived in the underground city built by Xue Ye's grandfather and they were trying to rebuild their lives. However, a gang of criminals who escaped from the prison of Exile Star showed up and tried to take over the underground city and seize the time machine invented by Xue Ye's grandfather, intending to wreak havoc across time and space. In order to fight off the gang and save the underground city, her grandfather sent Xue Ye back through time, hoping to go back to 2014 to seek the help of the brilliant scientist named "Zou Yuan." However, due to a malfunction, she mistakenly fell to 1994 and found the 15-year-old Zou Yuan instead. What's worse, several criminals from Exile Star also tracked Xue Ye through the time machine. Now Zou Yuan and his friends must work together to protect Xue Ye and fight off the criminals…

(Source: Baidu, translated)

193431.description:
Having surrendered himself to nature, Lu Shang became aware that he and God were all connected parts of nature. The mysterious god of the past appeared in front of him once again. The true identity of the god turned out to be "himself." The story ends with the famous meeting between Emperor Wen and Lu Shang.

A young woman awakes in the body of Guinevere, a princess in an obscure book who is to become queen of the Twilight Kingdom. This poor little princess won't take the abuse any longer - Guinevere is determined to take the throne that she deserves! But who is this mysterious "prince charming" who saved her?
